import copy, json
from work import evaluate

def check(req, ev, policy, expected):
    original = copy.deepcopy((req, ev, policy))
    actual = evaluate(req, ev, policy)
    assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
    assert (req, ev, policy) == original

# Supersession only by another eligible record; ineligible superseders have no effect.
check({'claim':'c','conditions':{'k':'x'}}, [
 {'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{'k':'x'},'verified':True},
 {'source':'bad-condition','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{'k':'y'},'verified':True,'supersedes':['old']},
 {'source':'unverified','claim':'c','value':3,'conditions':{'k':'x'},'supersedes':['old']}],
 {'required_conditions':['k'],'require_verified':True},
 {'status':'supported','value':1,'sources':['old'],'unknowns':[]})

# An eligible superseder removes every record with the superseded source ID.
check({'claim':'c','conditions':{}}, [
 {'source':'old','claim':'c','value':1,'conditions':{}},
 {'source':'old','claim':'c','value':2,'conditions':{}},
 {'source':'new','claim':'c','value':3,'conditions':{},'supersedes':'old'}],
 {'required_conditions':[]},
 {'status':'supported','value':3,'sources':['new'],'unknowns':[]})

# Extra non-required conditions do not prevent a required-condition match.
check({'claim':'c','conditions':{'k':1,'request_only':9}}, [
 {'source':'s','claim':'c','value':0,'conditions':{'k':1,'record_only':8}}],
 {'required_conditions':['k']},
 {'status':'supported','value':0,'sources':['s'],'unknowns':[]})

# Canonical JSON comparison makes object key order irrelevant while arrays remain ordered.
check({'claim':'c','conditions':{}}, [
 {'source':'a','claim':'c','value':{'a':1,'b':[2,3]},'conditions':{}},
 {'source':'b','claim':'c','value':{'b':[2,3],'a':1},'conditions':{}}],
 {'required_conditions':[]},
 {'status':'supported','value':{'a':1,'b':[2,3]},'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':[]})
check({'claim':'c','conditions':{}}, [
 {'source':'a','claim':'c','value':[1,2],'conditions':{}},
 {'source':'b','claim':'c','value':[2,1],'conditions':{}}],
 {'required_conditions':[]},
 {'status':'conflict','value':None,'sources':['a','b'],'unknowns':['source disagreement']})

requests=json.load(open('requests.json'))
evidence=json.load(open('evidence.json'))
policy=json.load(open('policy.json'))
assert json.load(open('report.json')) == [evaluate(r,evidence,policy) for r in requests]
print('independent boundary checks passed')
